title: Credit opened in someone else's identity
mechanism_summary: A thief uses stolen personal information to open a credit account. The person whose identity was used may discover unfamiliar debt or account activity.
suggested_beats: Personal information is stolen.
An unfamiliar credit account appears.
Review credit records and report unknown accounts.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone whose identity data was exposed
why_it_works: Formal-looking applications can conceal that the applicant is an impostor.

title: A utility account uses stolen personal details
mechanism_summary: Someone uses another person's identity to obtain utility or communications services. Charges and account records can then be associated with the wrong person.
suggested_beats: Identity details reach a thief.
An unknown service appears in records.
Dispute unrecognized accounts with the provider.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone receiving an unfamiliar service bill
why_it_works: Routine account creation can hide misuse until billing exposes it.

title: A child's identity finances an adult's borrowing
mechanism_summary: A thief uses a child's personal details to apply for credit or a loan. The misuse may remain unnoticed because the family does not expect the child to have financial accounts.
suggested_beats: A child's details are misused.
A loan appears under that identity.
Investigate unexpected credit activity involving a child.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: a caregiver protecting a child's identity
why_it_works: The assumption that children have no credit activity can delay discovery.

title: Medical care is billed under another identity
mechanism_summary: A person uses stolen insurance or identity information to obtain medical services. The misuse can generate unfamiliar bills and mix another patient's information into the victim's records.
suggested_beats: Medical details are stolen.
Unrecognized treatment appears on a statement.
Ask the provider to investigate and correct records.
why_it_works: Trusted billing paperwork can make identity misuse look like an ordinary charge.

title: A tax refund is claimed before the taxpayer files
mechanism_summary: A thief files a false tax return using another person's identity and collects the refund. The real taxpayer may discover the fraud when their own filing is rejected as a duplicate.
suggested_beats: An identity thief files first.
The genuine return is rejected.
Verify the rejection directly with the tax authority.
why_it_works: The fraud exploits an administrative process before the real claimant participates.

title: Unemployment benefits appear without an application
mechanism_summary: An identity thief applies for unemployment benefits using someone else's information. An unexpected benefits notice can reveal the claim even though the person never applied.
suggested_beats: A benefits claim uses stolen details.
An unsolicited notice arrives.
Report the false claim through the official benefits agency.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone receiving an unexpected benefits letter
why_it_works: A familiar government notice can obscure that the underlying application was fraudulent.

title: A delivered item manufactures a reviewer's identity
mechanism_summary: A seller sends an unsolicited low-value item to obtain apparent delivery validation. The seller then uses the recipient's identity to publish a fabricated review.
suggested_beats: A package arrives without an order.
Delivery supports a review the recipient never wrote.
Report the unsolicited shipment to the marketplace.
why_it_works: Delivery evidence can make invented customer testimony look authentic.

title: A stolen identity becomes a remote job application
mechanism_summary: Applicants use stolen personal information, sometimes alongside suspected voice manipulation, to apply for remote work. The identity owner did not authorize the application.
suggested_beats: A remote application presents borrowed credentials.
The applicant is not the identity holder.
Verify applicant identity independently.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone whose identity is used in recruitment
why_it_works: A plausible application can make stolen personal information look like legitimate credentials.
